units.source_text: “我的房间带了一间四叠大的会客室。

en.t: My room had a small anteroom of about four tatami mats.

units.source_text: 从玄关进屋后，要到我的房间来必须经过那里，

en.t: After entering from the front hall, one had to pass through it to reach my room.

units.source_text: 所以从实用的角度来看，那间小房极不方便，

en.t: So from a practical point of view, that little room was extremely inconvenient.

units.source_text: 我就把K安置在那间小屋里了。

en.t: I therefore put K in that little room.

units.source_text: 起初，我本想在八张席的房间里放上两个人的桌子，把那间小屋作为公共房间。

en.t: At first, I meant to put two desks in the eight-mat room and use the little room as a shared room.

units.source_text: 但是K说，即便狭窄一些，还是一个人住的好，就选了那间小房。

en.t: But K said that even if it was cramped, he preferred living alone, and chose the small room.

units.source_text: 正如上面我说过的，开始夫人是不赞成我这样做的。

en.t: As I said above, at first the lady of the house did not approve of my doing this.

units.source_text: 她说，要是开客店的话，两个人自然比一个人好，三个人要比两个人更合算，

en.t: She said that if they were running a lodging house, two people would naturally be better than one, and three more profitable than two.

units.source_text: 可她家不是店家，还是尽量不要带进其他人为好。

en.t: But her home was not a business, so it would be better not to bring anyone else in if possible.

units.source_text: 我说，您不用担心，他绝不会给别人添麻烦的。

en.t: I told her not to worry, because he would certainly not cause trouble for anyone.

units.source_text: 夫人又说，就算是这样，我也不喜欢不知秉性的人住进来。

en.t: The lady then said that even so, she disliked having someone whose character she did not know move in.

units.source_text: 我反问夫人，当初我来租房时，不是也不了解吗？

en.t: I asked her in return whether it had not been the same when I first came to rent a room.

units.source_text: 夫人争辩道，从一开始就很了解我的脾气，我露出了苦笑。

en.t: She insisted that she had understood my temperament well from the beginning, and I gave a wry smile.

units.source_text: 于是夫人又换了个理由，说不让我带他来，是因为对我不利。

en.t: Then the lady changed her reason, saying that I should not bring him because it would be bad for me.

units.source_text: 当我问她为什么会对我不利时，轮到夫人苦笑了。

en.t: When I asked why it would be bad for me, it was her turn to smile wryly.
